candidate.commit_oid: A COMMIT CANNOT CONTAIN ITS OWN OID. Recorded in the canonical repository as the git tag INV-R8-RECOVERY on refs/heads/invariant-canonical; scripts/factory-station.mjs verify checks the tag equals the ref and that the promoted tree reproduces tree_manifest_sha256.

invariants.note: THE JUMP FROM 120 TO 147 IN ONE TRANSITION IS THE RECOVERY, NOT AN ACHIEVEMENT. Twenty-one of the twenty-seven new records are INV-R6.1's and INV-R7's, replayed; six are this round's. The chain composes because 120 is INV-R6's `after` and this transition's parent is INV-R6 — which is the point: the previous head could not make that statement about itself.
retyped: FAC-RECEIPT-SCOPE-CLOSED — narrowed to registries-and-gates and SUPERSEDED by FAC-RECEIPT-EVIDENCE-CLOSED. Its statement was true at INV-R6.2 and covered a proper subset of the bytes a transition promotes, which is exactly where the exploit lived.
